notes: Partition verified: 40 source ids (one two-morpheme unit) and all 50 target ids used once.
*the men of the city* writes a *the* before each noun, so nothing is fronted under rule 29: the article takes the one standing before its own word and the construct a supplied one.
`בְּטֶרֶם` → *before* meets rule 30's one-rendering condition and is headed on `טֶרֶם`, which carries the lexeme.

`לוּלֵא` is one morpheme rendered discontinuously as *If ... not*, no second negative standing in the protasis; the head choice between *If* and *not* is named in the unit's note. The `Sd` of `הַחַרְסָה` takes the directional *down* under rules 32 and 11, with the phrasal-particle reading named.
